operation_contracts.output: next OrchestrationCursor plus an immutable zero-or-more CommandIntent batch

operation_contracts.input: expected cursor identity plus accepted event plus next cursor plus immutable command batch
immutable CommandIntent batch plus external authority reference
operation_contracts.effect: bounded parallel transport only; domain effect remains external

invariants: exactly one accepted-history authority exists per stream
RWO never accepts its own event history
cursor and the complete zero-or-more command batch are persisted atomically with the accepted event
finite acyclic graphs release root nodes immediately and dependency nodes only under declared all, any, or quorum policy
join inputs contain canonical successful dependency output references and impossible joins fail closed
attempts, parallelism, and the global deadline are explicit positive bounds
duplicate events are idempotent and divergent reuse of an event identity fails closed
protocol adapters cannot change structural meaning
DomainSpec owns recovery, retry, compensation, and terminal business disposition
unknown contracts, versions, operations, or protocols fail closed
